note: [L] carries readiness on every continuous input curve as Recipe.Issues.advances, proved in Lyrics.supplier. Since Issues quantifies over every subinterval, closure under restriction is built in rather than obtained by declaring a restricted selection to be the same choice.

snippet.text:
structure Issues (N p) : Prop where
  initial : ∃ F, Curve (a.budget N) (n:=a.S.side N p) F (band a N) ∧
      ∀ β∈band a N,(F β).beta=β ∧ Lives R N N p (F β) ∧ R.Starter N p (F β)
  advances (m : ℕ) : m < N →
    ∀ l u : ℝ, l ≤ u → ∀ Q, Curve (a.budget (m+1)) Q (Icc l u) →
      (∀ x∈ Icc l u, Lives R N (m+1) p (Q x) ∧ (Q x).beta ∈ band a (m+1)) →
      ∃ T, Curve (a.budget m) T (Icc l u) ∧
        ∀ x∈ Icc l u,Lives R N m p (T x) ∧ R.Relays N m p (T x) (Q x)

proof_context.conclusion: Readiness requires, for every interval [l,u] and every continuous admitted input curve Q on it, a continuous output curve T with Lives and Relays at every point.

lemma supplier (hG:G.Simple) : V.tunes.Issues N n:=by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨hf,h⟩:= V.origins N n
    refine ⟨V.start N n,hf,fun β hβ=>?_⟩; obtain ⟨he,hv,hr,hL⟩:= h β hβ
    exact ⟨he,(V.altitude).2 hv,hr.1,hr.2,⟨hr.inits,hL⟩,by rw [he]⟩
  intro m hm a s H Q hv hh
  obtain ⟨X,hr,hX⟩:= (V.prim N m n hm).spores a s H Q hv fun x hx=> ⟨(V.altitude).1 (hh x hx).1,(hh x hx).2⟩
  obtain ⟨hf,hF⟩:= X.moves hG hm
  refine ⟨X.result,hf,fun x hx=>?_⟩
  obtain ⟨h,hK,hp,hV⟩:= hF x hx
  exact ⟨(V.altitude).2 h.bundle,h.ident,(A.B.links hm h).drift,⟨h,⟨a,s,Q,X,x,hx,rfl,rfl⟩,by
    change |(X.result x).beta-(Q x).beta - A.B.kin.alpha N m|≤_
    unfold predictor at hK; rwa [sub_add_eq_sub_sub] at hK⟩,⟨hm,hX _ hx⟩⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Issues is proved by building the output for each given interval and curve with the step construction.
